boundary: the release itself: every defect live in the ported 4.0.0-rc2, whatever layer it reuses
title: Triaged: 165 defects live in 4.0.0-rc2, found by differential test extraction, with what each arm sees
live_in_pin_note: No cases are cut to the schema yet. Liveness is recorded per row in ledger.json instead, and it is measured rather than asserted: a row is here only because its own upstream test fails at the pin and passes at master. The rows are regenerated by probe/extract.py from an mruby clone, so this corpus carries the ledger and the harness rather than 674 generated files.
note: The published-advisory route is nearly empty at this pin: of 44 CVE/GHSA entries for mruby, 43 are already fixed in 4.0.0-rc2, and of 78 OSS-Fuzz OSV advisories, 73 are. This corpus exists because the defects that ARE live are the ones fixed after the pin, and upstream's own regression tests are the way to reach them.
